content_sections.heading: Lucknow University Subject Expert Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Lucknow University Subject Expert Selection Process 2026
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for Lucknow University Subject Expert Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for the Subject Expert post at Lucknow University?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Subject Expert post at Lucknow University is scheduled for 16 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they reach the venue on time on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the Subject Expert position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post Graduate degree with at least 55% marks and have qualified NET/JRF/Ph.D. The Post Graduation should be in M.A. in Women Studies or any Allied Subject like Hindi, English, Political Science, Philosophy, Sociology, Psychology, or Social Work.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Subject Expert post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 9 vacancies announced for the Subject Expert position at Lucknow University through this walk-in recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for the Subject Expert recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive. Candidates can attend the walk-in interview without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application for this recruitment is Walk-in. Interested and eligible candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q6. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies of these documents, and recent passport-size photographs. This includes ID proof, educational certificates, and any other relevant certificates.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Subject Expert role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Subject Expert role at Lucknow University will be based on an Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Subject Expert post at Lucknow University is Contractual. This means the appointment will be for a fixed tenure as per the terms of the contract.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview going to be held?
faq.answer: The exact venue address for the walk-in interview is not specified in the provided data. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for the complete venue details.
